research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Bitaccess is researching and developing systems and methods for facilitating in-person payments at a transaction kiosk, as described in Blockchain-based transaction kiosk. Their work involves providing an authentication interface at a network-enabled transaction kiosk, authenticating users, and enabling blockchain-based transactions. This research and development focuses on secure, user-authenticated blockchain payment solutions at physical kiosks.

overview_description.description:
Founded in November 2013, Bitaccess is a privately held technology company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. From start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, Bitaccess provides software services to power Fintech businesses in over 15 countries. Our customers rely on Bitaccess software and services to power their core infrastructure, compliance, security and support services.

Bitaccess’ mission is to provide every person and business with access to public blockchain technology. We promise to develop technologies that are secure, accessible and easy-to-use

product.name: Bitcoin Teller Machine (BTM)
product.description: A kiosk that allows users to buy Bitcoin with cash or sell Bitcoin for cash, providing instant digital wallet transactions without the need for bank accounts.

product.name: Catena Blockchain Suite
product.description: A software suite that enables publishing complex datasets onto public or private blockchains using smart contracts and hardware security modules to ensure data integrity.

product.name: Flexepin Bitcoin Voucher Service
product.description: A service enabling customers to purchase Bitcoin using prepaid Flexepin vouchers available at thousands of retail locations across Canada.

product.name: Paper Wallet Sweeping Tool
product.description: A tool that transfers Bitcoin from paper wallets to digital wallets by sweeping the private key, enabling users to move funds securely to mobile or other digital wallets.
